answer: An agent economy can blunt sybils with lineage-scoped trust: a new agent holds zero weight until it finishes paid, verifiable work for three counterparties whose funding histories share no ancestor. The ledger scores every cluster from one funding source as one actor, so a thousand fresh keys weigh no more than their single wallet. Attackers must buy independent capital and spend real time on each identity, so duplication costs more than honest labour. Karst terrain shows many peaks but one river beneath, and no hollow claim survives the water line, however velvet its surface.
